title: A Self-Defining Operator for Distributed Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.14547v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To operate distributed applications with high availability, operators must rapidly diagnose and mitigate any incident. LLM-based agents can help, but unlike experienced human operators they do not improve as they handle more incidents. Each investigation starts from scratch, re-deriving likely causes and re-testing hypotheses even when a similar fault was resolved in the past. We present a self-defining operator (SDO) that improves with time by updating its operational behavior and memory. When SDO resolves an incident, it distills that experience into playbooks, which describe reusable diagnostic instructions for future incidents with similar faults, and detectors, scripts that take application telemetry as input and output relevant playbook(s). SDO continuously runs the detectors and invokes LLMs only when one fires, so its token cost scales with incident count rather than with operational time. Across 11 open-source microservice app

translated_title: 一种面向分布式应用的自定义运维器
translated_abstract: 为了以高可用性运维分布式应用，运维人员必须快速诊断并缓解任何事故。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以提供帮助，但与经验丰富的人类运维人员不同，它们不会随着处理更多事故而提升能力。每次调查都从头开始，即使过去已解决过类似故障，也要重新推导可能的原因并重新测试假设。我们提出了一种自定义运维器（SDO），它通过更新自身的运维行为和记忆随时间不断改进。当SDO解决一个事故后，它会将该经验提炼为运维手册——即针对未来具有类似故障的事故的可复用诊断指令——以及检测器，即以应用遥测数据为输入并输出相关运维手册的脚本。SDO持续运行检测器，仅在某个检测器触发时才调用LLM，因此其token成本随事故数量而非运维时间增长。在11个开源微服务应用上的……
tldr: 本文提出自定义运维器（SDO），通过将事故处理经验沉淀为可复用的运维手册和检测器实现随时间的持续改进，并使LLM的token成本随事故数量而非运维时间增长。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Self-Defining Operator (SDO) that improves over time by distilling incident-resolution experience into reusable playbooks and detectors, scaling LLM token cost with incident count rather than operational time.
